operation.description:
Remove all previous custom labels and set the new custom labels for a specific
self-hosted runner configured in a repository.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the repository to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

labels.description: The names of the custom labels to set for the runner. You can pass an empty array to remove all custom labels.

operation.summary: Set custom labels for a self-hosted runner for a repository
